english.title: Collect information for use in immigration crime
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse

(A)_[collected or made a record of]_
(B)_[possessed a document or a record containing]_
(C)_[viewed or otherwise accessed by means of the internet a document or a record containing]_

information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), which was of a kind likely to be useful to a person organising or preparing for a journey or part of a journey involving the transportation of one or more individuals from a place outside the United Kingdom to a place within the United Kingdom, where the entry of any of those individuals into the United Kingdom, or the arrival of any of those individuals in the United Kingdom, would constitute an offence under section 24 of the Immigration Act 1971 and where there was a reasonable suspicion that the record or document, or any information contained in it, would be used by yourself or another person in organising or preparing for such a journey or part of such a journey
english.legislation: Contrary to section 16(1), (2) and (10) of the Border Security, Asylum and Immigration Act 2025.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
collected / made a record / possessed a document or record of / viewed / otherwise accessed by means of internet
information of a kind likely to be useful to a person organising or preparing for a relevant journey or part of such a journey
where there was reasonable suspicion that information of a kind was likely to be useful to a person organising or preparing for a relevant journey / part of such a journey

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Defences - Section 16(6) (defence of showing that a person's action or possession was for the purposes of a journey to be made only by them) and section 16(7) (reasonable excuse for action or possession).
(iii) This offence applies to conduct occurring both within and outside the United Kingdom (section 20).

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:None
